help.en: An area of the business that is responsible for its own data, such as Sales or Finance. It holds data products, data assets and glossary terms.
What consumers can rely on, such as "Refreshed daily by 06:00".
Teams or uses outside this model that rely on the product.
The people with an "Owns" connector to this product.

constraints.message: A published data product needs a steward.

help.en: Data that a team publishes for others to use, with an owner, a service level and known consumers.
How long the data is kept, as an ISO 8601 duration: P7Y is seven years, P90D is 90 days.
The share of the quality rules checking this asset that pass, from 0 to 100. Empty when no rule checks it.

constraints.message: A restricted data asset, or a confidential one with personal data, needs a policy ("Governed by").
A data asset with personal data should say how long it is kept.
The classification of this data asset differs from the classification it is linked to.

help.en: A table, file, stream, report or model that holds data. Its colour shows its classification.
How many things this person owns, stewards or looks after.
Someone who takes part in governance. Their roles come from their connectors: Owns, Stewards and Custodian of.
Other words people use for the same thing, separated by commas.

constraints.message: An approved glossary term needs a definition.

help.en: A business word with an agreed meaning, linked to the data it describes.

constraints.formula: EffectiveDate == null || ReviewDate == null || daysBetween(EffectiveDate, ReviewDate) > 0
constraints.message: The review date of a policy should come after its effective date.

help.en: A rule the organisation sets for its data: who may access it, how long it is kept, and so on.
How data at this level must be stored, shared and disposed of.
A sensitivity level and the handling it requires.
True when the last result reaches the threshold.
1 when passing, else 0. The quality score of a data asset averages it.

constraints.message: A quality rule should check at least one data asset.

help.en: A measurable check on the data, with a threshold and the last result.
The person is accountable for it and decides about it.
The person looks after its meaning, quality and use day to day.
The person runs the technical side: storage, access and backups.
The policy applies to it.
The data asset has this classification.
The glossary term gives the meaning of the data.
The quality rule is measured on this data asset.
The data product uses the data of another.
The data asset is part of the data product.
Domains, data products and data assets with their owners, stewards, custodians, policies, classifications, glossary terms and quality rules.
Glossary terms and the data products and data assets they define.

rule_failing.label: Warn when a quality rule fails

then.text: = 'Quality rule "' + Name + '" is below its threshold: ' + LastResult + '% of ' + Threshold + '%.'

scr_checkgov.name: Check governance
